plain.li: {X_nameDef} slept well in the guest room and said so. I helped build that room, so I'm counting it.
A guest liked the room. Small thing. I've thought about it all day.
[winter] {X_nameDef} said the guest room was warmer than anywhere on the road. Good. I fought for that stove.
{X_nameDef} asked who made the bed in the guest room. I said all of us, which is nearly true.

warm.li: We gave {X_nameDef} a good bed and a quiet night, and {X_pronoun} noticed. I've been smiling about it over my work.

blunt.li: The guest liked the room. Told you it was worth the wood.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} called our guest room "a little palace"! I'm going to put flowers in it.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} slept better here than I do. I've started eyeing the guest bed.

cold.li: Good rooms bring guests back, and guests bring silver. {X_nameDef} will be back.

plain.li: Took {X_nameDef} round the colony today. Seeing it through a stranger's eyes, it looks bigger than I thought.
{X_nameDef} wanted to see everything. I showed {X_objective} the fields, the pens and the wall. I left out the midden.
Showed {X_nameDef} where the first shelter stood, and {X_pronoun} asked how many of us there were then. Fewer.
[skill:Plants] {X_nameDef} knew three of our weeds by name and what they cure. I've stopped pulling one of them.

warm.li: I liked walking {X_nameDef} round. I'm proud of this place, and I don't get to say that often.

blunt.li: Gave the guest the tour. Too many questions, but good ones.

cheerful.li: I showed {X_nameDef} round, and {X_pronoun} spent half the tour making friends with the animals.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} asked what we do when raiders come. I said we hold the wall and count heads after.

cold.li: I showed the guest only what I wanted seen. The stores stayed shut.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} talked about home at supper, mostly about a brother who owes {X_objective} money. I could have listened all night.
{X_nameDef}'s home has a market every tenth day and a bridge that sways when you cross it.
[newcomer] {X_nameDef} asked where I'm from. I said here now, and was surprised to mean it.
[old] {X_nameDef}'s stories reminded me of my own village, and of how long ago that was.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} misses home so much it shows when {X_pronoun} talks about it. I hope {X_pronoun} gets back safe.

blunt.li: The guest talks a lot about home. If it's that good, why leave?

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef}'s people dance on the tables at weddings. On the tables! I want to go.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef}'s home sounds lovely. Most places do, from far enough away.

cold.li: Learned a good deal about {X_nameDef}'s people tonight, most of all who they quarrel with. Useful.

plain.li: Sat up with {X_nameDef}, who couldn't sleep. We talked until the fire was embers. I'm tired and I don't mind.
Found {X_nameDef} outside in the dark, homesick. Sat with {X_objective}. Didn't say much.
[clear] {X_nameDef} has different names for all our stars. The one we call the Ladle is a goat, apparently.

warm.li: Kept {X_nameDef} company in the dark until {X_pronoun} started yawning, then left my candle with {X_objective}.

blunt.li: Up half the night with the guest. Worth it, but I'll be useless tomorrow.

cheerful.li: Shared a midnight bowl of stew with {X_nameDef}! We've decided we're friends now.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} and I talked about the people we've lost. It was easier with a stranger.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} says more at night than in the day. I'll remember what was said.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} thanked me for the stay with a carved wooden bird. It's on my shelf now.
{X_nameDef} said ours was the best stop on the whole road. I'll take that.
[skill:Plants] {X_nameDef} left me seeds from home. They're going in the sunny corner by the wall.

warm.li: We looked after {X_nameDef}, and {X_pronoun} thanked us for it. I hope {X_pronoun} comes back.

blunt.li: The guest said thank you. Nice to be appreciated.

cheerful.li: A present from {X_nameDef}! I didn't even do anything special. Well, I did the breakfasts.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} was so grateful it made me wonder how other places treat travelers.

cold.li: A satisfied guest is worth ten traders. {X_nameDef} will talk about us on the road.
